old_row.relationship: The wilderness becomes fruitful and rejoices
old_row.rationale: Both picture wilderness places transformed into fruitful abundance and exultation. The psalm gives rich wilderness places and rejoicing hills; Isaiah commands the thirsty wilderness and desert places to flower and exult.

new_row.relationship: The wilderness becomes fruitful and rejoices
new_row.rationale: Both picture wilderness places transformed into abundance and exultation. The psalm says the beautiful wilderness places will grow rich and the hills will gird themselves with exultation. Isaiah35:1 commands the thirsty wilderness to rejoice and flower;35:2 says the Jordan's desert places will flower and exult.

old_row.relationship: Passage on foot through a river
old_row.rationale: The psalm speaks of passing through a river on foot. Joshua describes the priests and all Israel crossing the Jordan on dry ground. The river-crossing correspondence is kept distinct from the psalm's preceding sea image.

new_row.relationship: Passage on foot through a river
new_row.rationale: The psalm says that they will pass on foot through a river. Joshua describes the priests standing on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan while all Israel crosses on dry ground. The psalm's future wording and preceding sea image remain distinct from this Jordan account.
